header.title: Noa · family health
header.sub: Tap a person to open their record. Noa works step by step; you act when it’s your turn, or press Next<n/>.

tree.label: Family tree
tree.legend: Alia (Moza’s daughter, London) and Amna’s mother are not in this passport. Tap anyone to open their record.

welcome.h: Prevention and screening for one family
welcome.p: Tap anyone in the tree to choose them and open their record. Then a home screening: Noa detects from signals, the personal record and the family record, protects their data, runs a two-minute home screening (speech check and questions), and refers them to the right pathway within the guidelines, with the doctor’s decisions kept separate.

khalid.d: Feels fine, smokes, never screened. Genetic cholesterol risk.

em.title: Urgency: immediate
em.text: {{name}} should see a doctor now (emergency department). Screening paused.

sync.ago: synced {{n}} s ago · simulated in this prototype
sync.s1: Watch, BP cuff, scale and glucose sensor record readings (watch heart rate every few minutes at rest; irregular-rhythm alerts as they happen)
sync.s2: They land in Apple Health (HealthKit) or Health Connect on the phone
sync.s3: The InsideSync app syncs them in the background, within minutes
sync.s4: A signed, consent-checked request sends them to No One Alone (built and tested locally, not yet deployed)
sync.s5: The Personal care agent reads them against {{name}}’s own normal

pattern.lab: Noa Guardian · live pattern check against {{name}}’s own normal · simulated readings
pattern.foot: How it works: each reading is compared with {{name}}’s own 14-day band, not an average person. A check is prompted only when a value stays outside the band (heart: 10+ minutes at rest) or crosses a safety threshold. In real life the readings sync from the devices through the InsideSync app.

famw.lab: Family health record · how Noa used it for {{name}}
famw.foot: Changes the plan · – considered, no change. Relatives’ conditions are used only with their consent; details are never shown to other relatives, only the effect.

flags.lab: Why {{name}} is flagged · population priority, not a diagnosis

vt.plan: Home screening by voice · chosen for {{name}}

path.pp: Population priority · within the guideline · Noa can book
path.cd: Clinical decisions · only the doctor decides
path.nonePp: Nothing is due by the guideline right now.
path.noneCd: Nothing needs a clinical decision now.
path.foot: Each item has an urgency level and a due-by date (rule U1); anything urgent is escalated to the doctor even if the person says “not now”. Noa ranks and books population checks; it never diagnoses or treats. Guideline lines are a demo summary of Department of Health programmes, to be confirmed before a pilot.

protect.q: What may Noa use, and who may see the pathway?
protect.genomic: Genomic result (optional; can be switched off)

din.hint: · press play to hear three digits over background noise, then type them. Use headphones in real life.
din.foot: Simplified 3-round demo of the digits-in-noise method (the validated test uses about 23 triplets with adaptive noise). The answers are pre-filled for the demo; change them to try.

spx.title: Noa Speech Check
spx.sub: Compares today’s voice with {{name}}’s own voice, not an average
spx.runsHim: Runs when Noa needs to check on him. {{name}} repeats one short sentence.
spx.runsHer: Runs when Noa needs to check on her. {{name}} repeats one short sentence.
spx.prompt: {{name}}, please say this sentence after me: {{sentence}}.
spx.noaSays: Noa is reading the sentence; the microphone opens when she finishes…
spx.takeTime: Take your time: speak at your own pace. Noa keeps listening through pauses and stops about 3 seconds after your last word (at most 20 seconds), or press Done.
spx.noMic: No microphone here: type the sentence in the box below, or use a sample.
spx.c2: One sentence when Noa needs to check
spx.c3His: 5 measures compared with his own normal, in under 2 seconds
spx.c3Her: 5 measures compared with her own normal, in under 2 seconds
spx.c4: Clearly changed = Red: Noa stops and advises seeing a doctor immediately
spx.foot: Runs when Noa sees an unusual pattern, or as a recovery check after a stroke; never as a routine screening test for people without symptoms. Accent and hearing aids are part of the baseline; only the scores are kept, not the recordings. Noa’s own method, to be validated in the pilot; numbers here are illustrative.
spx.micOff: The microphone is off for this page. Type instead, or use a sample.
spx.micFail: Speech-to-text did not start. Type instead, or use a sample.
spx.noWords: No words came through. Try again, type it, or use a sample.

team.sub: Live: who holds the case and every hand-off
team.wait: Waiting for a person to look after
team.foot: AI agents write and read the words. The Orchestrator’s rules choose the next agent. People decide treatment.
